intro: ^It is the Boshin War of 1868. Rebellious forces of the Imperial Court are attempting to overthrow the Tokugawa Shogunate and restore power to the Meiji Emperor. The Shogunate's force resists, however, to protect the interests of their ancestral allies.

^While we suffered through disparity and hunger, the Shogunate hypocritically shook hands from the very Western powers that broke their imposed isolation and flooded our lands with guns, tainting the principles of what makes one a samurai. Now, we must fight fire with fire.

^Convinced by Imperial courtiers of His Majesty's approval, the centrally-located Tsu & Yodo domains have defected from the Shogunate's alliance just as they have begun a new offensive... and I am the messenger sent to ensure this information reaches the Emperor's camp, tasked with traveling through the hell of battle.

^I've abandoned the blade along ago. But in order for my children to live comfortable lives, I must honorably carry out my duty as a messenger for the Emperor, for the nation we swore to protect. The Shogunate has no chance, they lack the military strength to overcome our forces, and if this shift in the balance of power is made known, coordination on the strengthened Imperial side will allow this war to end with less bloodshed.
^Even though our Imperial allies roam the lands with these appalling western designs, I will never touch a gun. I ride and run for peace.
^My hands will stay the hands of a samurai.
